Google Sheets Data Sync

Local / Offline
Google Apps Script Code (Copy into Apps Script) 
function doGet(e) {
  var sheet = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().getActiveSheet();
  var data = sheet.getDataRange().getValues();
  var result = [];
  for (var i = 1; i < data.length; i++) {
    result.push({
      id: data[i][0],
      date: data[i][1],
      title: data[i][2],
      category: data[i][3],
      paidBy: data[i][4],
      amount: data[i][5],
      includedMembers: data[i][6] ? data[i][6].split(",") : []
    });
  }
  return ContentService.createTextOutput(JSON.stringify(result)).setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.JSON);
}

function doPost(e) {
  var sheet = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().getActiveSheet();
  var data = JSON.parse(e.postData.contents);
  if (sheet.getLastRow() === 0) {
    sheet.appendRow(["ID", "Date", "Title", "Category", "Paid By", "Amount", "Included Members"]);
  }
  sheet.appendRow([data.id, data.date, data.title, data.category, data.paidBy, data.amount, data.includedMembers.join(",")]);
  return ContentService.createTextOutput(JSON.stringify({"result": "success"})).setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.JSON);
}
